stories.title: Video of British student handcuffed by police while dying sparks outrage and riots
stories.summary: There is outrage in the U.K. over the murder of 18-year-old Henry Nowak. Bodycam footage shows police handcuffing him as he lay dying. His killer falsely accused Nowak of racist abuse.

stories.title: Peabo Bryson, R&B singer behind some iconic Disney songs, has died at 75
stories.summary: Peabo Bryson, the legendary singer behind Beauty and the Beast and 'A Whole New World,' has died at 75.

stories.title: As Strait of Hormuz stays shut, companies seek new routes for trade
stories.summary: Shipping companies are looking for alternative routes as the Strait of Hormuz lockdown drags on.

stories.title: San Antonio's Catholic sisters grab the spotlight during the NBA Finals
stories.summary: Four nuns have become San Antonio fan favorites during the Spurs' playoff run. They'll be at the arena Wednesday as the Spurs host the New York Knicks at the start of the NBA Finals.

stories.title: A former GEO Group executive now runs ICE. The company's government ties run deep
stories.summary: ICE's new acting director started this week. He's a former executive with GEO Group, the prison contractor that has seen huge financial gains as the Trump administration ramps up immigrant detentions.

stories.title: A science powerhouse bets on genetic therapy to beat brain disorders
stories.summary: After spending two decades studying how the brain works, a team of scientists prepares to focus on gene therapy treatments for brain diseases, including Alzheimer's and Parkinson's.
